The brand theme compiler (L5) writes\n * the prospect's own values over them at emit time; the artifact never wears the\n * studio's palette.\n */\n\n:root {\n --pp-primary: #1a1a1a;\n --pp-on-primary: #ffffff;\n --pp-secondary: #4a4a4a;\n --pp-on-secondary: #ffffff;\n --pp-surface: #ffffff;\n --pp-on-surface: #16181d;\n --pp-surface-alt: #f4f5f7;\n --pp-on-surface-alt: #16181d;\n --pp-accent: #2f5bd8;\n --pp-on-accent: #ffffff;\n --pp-border: #d9dce1;\n --pp-success: #17693f;\n --pp-warning: #8a5a00;\n --pp-danger: #a32020;\n\n --pp-font-display: system-ui, sans-serif;\n --pp-font-body: system-ui, sans-serif;\n --pp-font-mono: ui-monospace, monospace;\n\n --pp-radius: 8px;\n --pp-border-width: 1px;\n --pp-shadow: none;\n\n --pp-transition-ms: 200ms;\n --pp-stage-pad: clamp(20px, 3.2vw, 56px);\n --pp-scale: 1;\n}\n\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\n\nhtml, body {\n margin: 0;\n padding: 0;\n height: 100%;\n background: var(--pp-surface);\n color: var(--pp-on-surface);\n font-family: var(--pp-font-body);\n -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ stage */\n\n.pp-stage {\n position: relative;\n height: 100%;\n min-height: 100vh;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n overflow: hidden;\n background: var(--pp-surface);\n}\n\n.pp-stage-scene {\n flex: 1;\n min-height: 0;\n display: flex;\n}\n\n.pp-scene {\n flex: 1;\n min-height: 0;\n overflow-y: auto;\n overflow-x: hidden;\n padding: var(--pp-stage-pad);\n scroll-behavior: smooth;\n}\n\n[data-pp-reduced-motion=\"true\"] .pp-scene { scroll-behavior: auto; }\n\n/* --------------------------------------------------------------- reveals */\n\n[data-pp-el] {\n transition:\n opacity var(--pp-transition-ms) ease,\n transform var(--pp-transition-ms) ease;\n}\n\n.pp-unrevealed {\n opacity: 0;\n transform: translateY(8px);\n pointer-events: none;\n /* Hidden reveals keep their box so nothing reflows when a beat lands. A\n layout that jumps as each beat arrives reads as a bug from the third row. */\n visibility: hidden;\n transition: none;\n}\n\n.pp-revealed {\n opacity: 1;\n transform: none;\n visibility: visible;\n}\n\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n [data-pp-el] { transition: none; }\n .pp-unrevealed { transform: none; }\n}\n\n/* ----------------------------------------------------------- blank screen */\n\n.pp-blank {\n position: absolute;\n inset: 0;\n background: var(--pp-primary);\n z-index: 40;\n}\n\n.pp-stage--blank .pp-stage-scene { visibility: hidden; }\n\n/* ---------------------------------------------------------- branch badge */\n\n.pp-branch-badge {\n position: absolute;\n left: var(--pp-stage-pad);\n bottom: 16px;\n z-index: 30;\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n gap: 10px;\n padding: 6px 12px;\n border-radius: 999px;\n background: var(--pp-surface-alt);\n color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt);\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n font-size: 13px;\n max-width: min(60ch, 70vw);\n}\n\n.pp-branch-badge-label {\n overflow: hidden;\n text-overflow: ellipsis;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-branch-badge-key {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 11px;\n opacity: 0.75;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n/* -------------------------------------------------------------- overlays */\n\n.pp-overlay-layer {\n position: absolute;\n inset: 0;\n z-index: 50;\n display: flex;\n align-items: flex-start;\n justify-content: center;\n padding: clamp(24px, 6vh, 80px) 24px;\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-on-surface) 45%, transparent);\n backdrop-filter: blur(2px);\n}\n\n.pp-overlay {\n width: min(760px, 100%);\n max-height: 100%;\n overflow-y: auto;\n background: var(--pp-surface);\n color: var(--pp-on-surface);\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n box-shadow: var(--pp-shadow);\n padding: 24px;\n}\n\n.pp-overlay-title {\n margin: 0 0 16px;\n font-family: var(--pp-font-display);\n font-size: 20px;\n}\n\n.pp-overlay-foot {\n margin: 20px 0 0;\n font-size: 12px;\n opacity: 0.7;\n}\n\n.pp-help-groups {\n display: grid;\n gap: 20px;\n grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));\n}\n\n.pp-help-group-title {\n margin: 0 0 8px;\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.09em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n}\n\n.pp-help-list {\n margin: 0;\n display: grid;\n grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;\n gap: 4px 12px;\n align-items: baseline;\n}\n\n.pp-help-key {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 12px;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-help-label { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; }\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------ provenance label (§9/§18) */\n\n/*\n * The illustrative label. §18.1: the label \"cannot be styled to invisibility\",\n * and the emitter checks the computed result against the final stylesheet. The\n * floors below are the ones it enforces — a size floor of 11px and a real\n * contrast pair — so this rule is not decoration, it is the law's implementation.\n */\n.pp-provenance {\n display: inline-flex;\n align-items: center;\n gap: 6px;\n padding: 3px 8px;\n border-radius: 4px;\n background: var(--pp-warning);\n color: var(--pp-on-primary);\n font-family: var(--pp-font-body);\n font-size: 12px;\n line-height: 1.35;\n font-weight: 600;\n letter-spacing: 0.01em;\n opacity: 1;\n visibility: visible;\n}\n\n/* --------------------------------------------------- placeholder fallback */\n\n.pp-layout--placeholder {\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n justify-content: center;\n min-height: 60vh;\n}\n\n.pp-placeholder-card {\n border: var(--pp-border-width) dashed var(--pp-border);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n padding: 28px 32px;\n max-width: 60ch;\n text-align: center;\n}\n\n.pp-placeholder-kicker {\n margin: 0 0 8px;\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.09em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n color: var(--pp-danger);\n}\n\n.pp-placeholder-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: var(--pp-font-display); }\n.pp-placeholder-sub { margin: 0 0 12px; opacity: 0.75; }\n.pp-placeholder-code { font-family: var(--pp-font-mono); font-size: 12px; }\n\n.pp-scene--empty {\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n justify-content: center;\n opacity: 0.6;\n}\n\n/* src/branch/branch.css */\n/*\n * L9 branch overlays: the jump index, the branch map and the contents index.\n *\n * These extend the `pp-overlay` shell that `src/runtime/runtime.css` owns; they\n * never redefine a class the runtime owns (API.md, Artifact CSS). Every colour\n * comes from a `--pp-*` role variable, so the panels wear the prospect's brand\n * like the rest of the artifact and nothing here can leak studio chrome (D11).\n *\n * NOTE FOR THE INTEGRATOR: `scripts/build.mjs` concatenates CSS from\n * `src/runtime/**` and `src/scene/**` only. This file must be added to that\n * list, or the overlays render unstyled in the emitted artifact.\n */\n\n.pp-overlay--jump,\n.pp-overlay--map,\n.pp-overlay--contents {\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 14px;\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------- jump index */\n\n.pp-jump-field {\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n gap: 12px;\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n padding: 10px 14px;\n background: var(--pp-surface-alt);\n}\n\n.pp-jump-input {\n flex: 1;\n min-width: 0;\n border: 0;\n background: transparent;\n color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt);\n font-family: var(--pp-font-body);\n font-size: 20px;\n line-height: 1.3;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-input:focus { outline: none; }\n.pp-jump-input::placeholder { color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt); opacity: 0.5; }\n\n.pp-jump-count {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 12px;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-results {\n list-style: none;\n margin: 0;\n padding: 0;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 2px;\n max-height: 46vh;\n overflow-y: auto;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result {\n display: grid;\n grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;\n grid-template-areas: 'objection meta' 'alias meta';\n align-items: baseline;\n gap: 2px 16px;\n padding: 10px 12px;\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n border-left: 3px solid transparent;\n cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result--active {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 14%, transparent);\n border-left-color: var(--pp-accent);\n}\n\n.pp-jump-objection {\n grid-area: objection;\n font-size: 17px;\n line-height: 1.35;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-alias {\n grid-area: alias;\n font-size: 13px;\n opacity: 0.72;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-meta {\n grid-area: meta;\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.04em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result--shown .pp-jump-objection { opacity: 0.62; }\n\n.pp-jump-hit {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 26%, transparent);\n color: inherit;\n border-radius: 3px;\n padding: 0 1px;\n font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-empty {\n margin: 0;\n padding: 14px 12px;\n font-size: 15px;\n opacity: 0.7;\n}\n\n/* -------------------------------------------------------------- branch map */\n\n.pp-map-here {\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n border-left: 3px solid var(--pp-accent);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n padding: 12px 14px;\n background: var(--pp-surface-alt);\n color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt);\n}\n\n.pp-map-heading {\n margin: 0 0 6px;\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.09em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n}\n\n.pp-map-here-line { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; }\n.pp-map-here-seq { font-weight: 700; }\n.pp-map-here-scene { opacity: 0.7; font-family: var(--pp-font-mono); font-size: 12px; }\n.pp-map-here-title { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: var(--pp-font-display); font-size: 17px; }\n.pp-map-here-return { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 13px; }\n.pp-map-here-policy { opacity: 0.6; }\n\n.pp-map-section { margin: 0; }\n\n.pp-map-spine,\n.pp-map-loose {\n list-style: none;\n margin: 0;\n padding: 0;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 2px;\n}\n\n.pp-map-scene {\n display: grid;\n grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr auto;\n align-items: baseline;\n gap: 4px 10px;\n padding: 7px 10px;\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.pp-map-scene--shown { opacity: 0.66; }\n\n.pp-map-scene--current {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 14%, transparent);\n opacity: 1;\n font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.pp-map-index { font-family: var(--pp-font-mono); font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.6; }\n.pp-map-title { font-size: 15px; }\n\n.pp-map-state {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 10px;\n letter-spacing: 0.08em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-map-anchors {\n grid-column: 2 / -1;\n list-style: none;\n margin: 4px 0 0;\n padding: 0;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 2px;\n}\n\n.pp-map-anchor {\n display: flex;\n align-items: baseline;\n justify-content: space-between;\n gap: 12px;\n padding: 5px 10px;\n border-left: 2px solid var(--pp-border);\n border-radius: 0 var(--pp-radius) var(--pp-radius) 0;\n font-size: 13px;\n font-weight: 400;\n cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n/*\n * Unshown branches are the point of this panel (§11), so they carry the accent\n * and shown ones recede. }\n\n.pp-contents-item--current {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 12%, transparent);\n font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.pp-contents-item--seen .pp-contents-title { opacity: 0.7; }\n\n.pp-contents-index { grid-area: index; font-family: var(--pp-font-mono); font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.6; }\n.pp-contents-title { grid-area: title; font-size: 16px; }\n.pp-contents-sub { grid-area: sub; font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.65; }\n\n.pp-contents-beats {\n grid-area: beats;\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 11px;\n opacity: 0.55;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n .pp-jump-result,\n .pp-map-scene,\n .pp-contents-item { transition: none; }\n}\n\n/* src/scene/scenes.css */\n/*\n * The scene stylesheet (L8).\n *\n * Bundled into `dist/pitchproof-runtime.css` behind `src/runtime/runtime.css`\n * and inlined into every artifact, so everything here is subject to the\n * artifact's laws rather than the studio's conveniences:\n *\n * - **`--pp-*` variables only** (D11, §15). The studio chrome's own variable\n * namespace may not appear anywhere under `src/scene/`, and\n * test/scene/css-agreement.test.mjs fails the build on any occurrence of it.\n * Colour comes from the brand theme's `--pp-*` roles; no literal hex\n * appears below, because the artifact wears the prospect's brand and\n * nobody else's.\n * - **No network of any kind** (§13): no imported stylesheet, no font URL, no\n * image URL, no remote anything. Every visual is a border, a background, a\n * gradient over brand colours, or inline SVG in the markup. The rule is\n * checked by test/scene/css-agreement.test.mjs over the whole directory,\n * including this comment — the file is bundled into the artifact verbatim.\n * - **The §10 motion budget**: the only animated properties are `opacity` and\n * `transform`, every duration is `var(--pp-transition-ms)` (200ms, capped at\n * 240 by `transitionMs()` in runtime/beats.js), and\n * `prefers-reduced-motion` removes them. Transitions on those two\n * properties are interruptible by definition — a reveal reversed mid-flight\n * lands on the state the beat engine asked for, never on a partial one.\n *\n * ------------------------------------------------------------------ geometry\n *\n * Every number in the `:root` blocks below is generated from `GEOM` and\n * `TYPE_ROLES` in `src/scene/tokens.js`, which is also what `measureScene()`\n * measures with. The two cannot drift: `test/scene/css-agreement.test.mjs`\n * parses this file and asserts each `:root` block declares exactly\n * `sceneVars(bp)`, and that each `[data-pp-tx]` rule matches its `TYPE_ROLES`\n * entry, value for value.\n *\n * The vertical model, for reading the rules below:\n *\n * content box = viewport - 2 x --pp-stage-pad (runtime.css)\n * header band = --pp-sc-head-h\n * body box = content box - header band - --pp-sc-head-gap\n *\n * Dimensions produced by a grid rather than by a token — the equal columns of a\n * split, the equal cards of a fan — are computed in geometry.js with the\n * formula `repeat(n, minmax(0,1fr))` plus `gap` actually produces, so the\n * agreement there is structural rather than copied.\n */\n\n/* sm — the base block: 390px viewport This file must be added to that\n * list, or the overlays render unstyled in the emitted artifact.\n */\n\n.pp-overlay--jump,\n.pp-overlay--map,\n.pp-overlay--contents {\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 14px;\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------- jump index */\n\n.pp-jump-field {\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n gap: 12px;\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n padding: 10px 14px;\n background: var(--pp-surface-alt);\n}\n\n.pp-jump-input {\n flex: 1;\n min-width: 0;\n border: 0;\n background: transparent;\n color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt);\n font-family: var(--pp-font-body);\n font-size: 20px;\n line-height: 1.3;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-input:focus { outline: none; }\n.pp-jump-input::placeholder { color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt); opacity: 0.5; }\n\n.pp-jump-count {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 12px;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-results {\n list-style: none;\n margin: 0;\n padding: 0;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 2px;\n max-height: 46vh;\n overflow-y: auto;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result {\n display: grid;\n grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;\n grid-template-areas: 'objection meta' 'alias meta';\n align-items: baseline;\n gap: 2px 16px;\n padding: 10px 12px;\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n border-left: 3px solid transparent;\n cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result--active {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 14%, transparent);\n border-left-color: var(--pp-accent);\n}\n\n.pp-jump-objection {\n grid-area: objection;\n font-size: 17px;\n line-height: 1.35;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-alias {\n grid-area: alias;\n font-size: 13px;\n opacity: 0.72;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-meta {\n grid-area: meta;\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.04em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result--shown .pp-jump-objection { opacity: 0.62; }\n\n.pp-jump-hit {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 26%, transparent);\n color: inherit;\n border-radius: 3px;\n padding: 0 1px;\n font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-empty {\n margin: 0;\n padding: 14px 12px;\n font-size: 15px;\n opacity: 0.7;\n}\n\n/* -------------------------------------------------------------- branch map */\n\n.pp-map-here {\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n border-left: 3px solid var(--pp-accent);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n padding: 12px 14px;\n background: var(--pp-surface-alt);\n color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt);\n}\n\n.pp-map-heading {\n margin: 0 0 6px;\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.09em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n}\n\n.pp-map-here-line { margin: 0; The brand theme compiler (L5) writes\n * the prospect's own values over them at emit time; the artifact never wears the\n * studio's palette.\n */\n\n:root {\n --pp-primary: #1a1a1a;\n --pp-on-primary: #ffffff;\n --pp-secondary: #4a4a4a;\n --pp-on-secondary: #ffffff;\n --pp-surface: #ffffff;\n --pp-on-surface: #16181d;\n --pp-surface-alt: #f4f5f7;\n --pp-on-surface-alt: #16181d;\n --pp-accent: #2f5bd8;\n --pp-on-accent: #ffffff;\n --pp-border: #d9dce1;\n --pp-success: #17693f;\n --pp-warning: #8a5a00;\n --pp-danger: #a32020;\n\n --pp-font-display: system-ui, sans-serif;\n --pp-font-body: system-ui, sans-serif;\n --pp-font-mono: ui-monospace, monospace;\n\n --pp-radius: 8px;\n --pp-border-width: 1px;\n --pp-shadow: none;\n\n --pp-transition-ms: 200ms;\n --pp-stage-pad: clamp(20px, 3.2vw, 56px);\n --pp-scale: 1;\n}\n\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\n\nhtml, body {\n margin: 0;\n padding: 0;\n height: 100%;\n background: var(--pp-surface);\n color: var(--pp-on-surface);\n font-family: var(--pp-font-body);\n -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ stage */\n\n.pp-stage {\n position: relative;\n height: 100%;\n min-height: 100vh;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n overflow: hidden;\n background: var(--pp-surface);\n}\n\n.pp-stage-scene {\n flex: 1;\n min-height: 0;\n display: flex;\n}\n\n.pp-scene {\n flex: 1;\n min-height: 0;\n overflow-y: auto;\n overflow-x: hidden;\n padding: var(--pp-stage-pad);\n scroll-behavior: smooth;\n}\n\n[data-pp-reduced-motion=\"true\"] .pp-scene { scroll-behavior: auto; }\n\n/* --------------------------------------------------------------- reveals */\n\n[data-pp-el] {\n transition:\n opacity var(--pp-transition-ms) ease,\n transform var(--pp-transition-ms) ease;\n}\n\n.pp-unrevealed {\n opacity: 0;\n transform: translateY(8px);\n pointer-events: none;\n /* Hidden reveals keep their box so nothing reflows when a beat lands. A\n layout that jumps as each beat arrives reads as a bug from the third row. */\n visibility: hidden;\n transition: none;\n}\n\n.pp-revealed {\n opacity: 1;\n transform: none;\n visibility: visible;\n}\n\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n [data-pp-el] { transition: none; }\n .pp-unrevealed { transform: none; }\n}\n\n/* ----------------------------------------------------------- blank screen */\n\n.pp-blank {\n position: absolute;\n inset: 0;\n background: var(--pp-primary);\n z-index: 40;\n}\n\n.pp-stage--blank .pp-stage-scene { visibility: hidden; }\n\n/* ---------------------------------------------------------- branch badge */\n\n.pp-branch-badge {\n position: absolute;\n left: var(--pp-stage-pad);\n bottom: 16px;\n z-index: 30;\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n gap: 10px;\n padding: 6px 12px;\n border-radius: 999px;\n background: var(--pp-surface-alt);\n color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt);\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n font-size: 13px;\n max-width: min(60ch, 70vw);\n}\n\n.pp-branch-badge-label {\n overflow: hidden;\n text-overflow: ellipsis;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-branch-badge-key {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 11px;\n opacity: 0.75;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n/* -------------------------------------------------------------- overlays */\n\n.pp-overlay-layer {\n position: absolute;\n inset: 0;\n z-index: 50;\n display: flex;\n align-items: flex-start;\n justify-content: center;\n padding: clamp(24px, 6vh, 80px) 24px;\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-on-surface) 45%, transparent);\n backdrop-filter: blur(2px);\n}\n\n.pp-overlay {\n width: min(760px, 100%);\n max-height: 100%;\n overflow-y: auto;\n background: var(--pp-surface);\n color: var(--pp-on-surface);\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n box-shadow: var(--pp-shadow);\n padding: 24px;\n}\n\n.pp-overlay-title {\n margin: 0 0 16px;\n font-family: var(--pp-font-display);\n font-size: 20px;\n}\n\n.pp-overlay-foot {\n margin: 20px 0 0;\n font-size: 12px;\n opacity: 0.7;\n}\n\n.pp-help-groups {\n display: grid;\n gap: 20px;\n grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));\n}\n\n.pp-help-group-title {\n margin: 0 0 8px;\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.09em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n}\n\n.pp-help-list {\n margin: 0;\n display: grid;\n grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;\n gap: 4px 12px;\n align-items: baseline;\n}\n\n.pp-help-key {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 12px;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-help-label { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; }\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------ provenance label (§9/§18) */\n\n/*\n * The illustrative label. §18.1: the label \"cannot be styled to invisibility\",\n * and the emitter checks the computed result against the final stylesheet. The\n * floors below are the ones it enforces — a size floor of 11px and a real\n * contrast pair — so this rule is not decoration, it is the law's implementation.\n */\n.pp-provenance {\n display: inline-flex;\n align-items: center;\n gap: 6px;\n padding: 3px 8px;\n border-radius: 4px;\n background: var(--pp-warning);\n color: var(--pp-on-primary);\n font-family: var(--pp-font-body);\n font-size: 12px;\n line-height: 1.35;\n font-weight: 600;\n letter-spacing: 0.01em;\n opacity: 1;\n visibility: visible;\n}\n\n/* --------------------------------------------------- placeholder fallback */\n\n.pp-layout--placeholder {\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n justify-content: center;\n min-height: 60vh;\n}\n\n.pp-placeholder-card {\n border: var(--pp-border-width) dashed var(--pp-border);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n padding: 28px 32px;\n max-width: 60ch;\n text-align: center;\n}\n\n.pp-placeholder-kicker {\n margin: 0 0 8px;\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.09em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n color: var(--pp-danger);\n}\n\n.pp-placeholder-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: var(--pp-font-display); }\n.pp-placeholder-sub { margin: 0 0 12px; opacity: 0.75; }\n.pp-placeholder-code { font-family: var(--pp-font-mono); font-size: 12px; }\n\n.pp-scene--empty {\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n justify-content: center;\n opacity: 0.6;\n}\n\n/* src/branch/branch.css */\n/*\n * L9 branch overlays: the jump index, the branch map and the contents index.\n *\n * These extend the `pp-overlay` shell that `src/runtime/runtime.css` owns; they\n * never redefine a class the runtime owns (API.md, Artifact CSS). Every colour\n * comes from a `--pp-*` role variable, so the panels wear the prospect's brand\n * like the rest of the artifact and nothing here can leak studio chrome (D11).\n *\n * NOTE FOR THE INTEGRATOR: `scripts/build.mjs` concatenates CSS from\n * `src/runtime/**` and `src/scene/**` only. This file must be added to that\n * list, or the overlays render unstyled in the emitted artifact.\n */\n\n.pp-overlay--jump,\n.pp-overlay--map,\n.pp-overlay--contents {\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 14px;\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------- jump index */\n\n.pp-jump-field {\n display: flex;\n align-items: center;\n gap: 12px;\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n padding: 10px 14px;\n background: var(--pp-surface-alt);\n}\n\n.pp-jump-input {\n flex: 1;\n min-width: 0;\n border: 0;\n background: transparent;\n color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt);\n font-family: var(--pp-font-body);\n font-size: 20px;\n line-height: 1.3;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-input:focus { outline: none; }\n.pp-jump-input::placeholder { color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt); opacity: 0.5; }\n\n.pp-jump-count {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 12px;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-results {\n list-style: none;\n margin: 0;\n padding: 0;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 2px;\n max-height: 46vh;\n overflow-y: auto;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result {\n display: grid;\n grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;\n grid-template-areas: 'objection meta' 'alias meta';\n align-items: baseline;\n gap: 2px 16px;\n padding: 10px 12px;\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n border-left: 3px solid transparent;\n cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result--active {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 14%, transparent);\n border-left-color: var(--pp-accent);\n}\n\n.pp-jump-objection {\n grid-area: objection;\n font-size: 17px;\n line-height: 1.35;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-alias {\n grid-area: alias;\n font-size: 13px;\n opacity: 0.72;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-meta {\n grid-area: meta;\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.04em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result--shown .pp-jump-objection { opacity: 0.62; }\n\n.pp-jump-hit {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 26%, transparent);\n color: inherit;\n border-radius: 3px;\n padding: 0 1px;\n font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-empty {\n margin: 0;\n padding: 14px 12px;\n font-size: 15px;\n opacity: 0.7;\n}\n\n/* -------------------------------------------------------------- branch map */\n\n.pp-map-here {\n border: var(--pp-border-width) solid var(--pp-border);\n border-left: 3px solid var(--pp-accent);\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n padding: 12px 14px;\n background: var(--pp-surface-alt);\n color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt);\n}\n\n.pp-map-heading {\n margin: 0 0 6px;\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.09em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n}\n\n.pp-map-here-line { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; }\n.pp-map-here-seq { font-weight: 700; }\n.pp-map-here-scene { opacity: 0.7; font-family: var(--pp-font-mono); font-size: 12px; }\n.pp-map-here-title { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: var(--pp-font-display); font-size: 17px; }\n.pp-map-here-return { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 13px; }\n.pp-map-here-policy { opacity: 0.6; }\n\n.pp-map-section { margin: 0; }\n\n.pp-map-spine,\n.pp-map-loose {\n list-style: none;\n margin: 0;\n padding: 0;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 2px;\n}\n\n.pp-map-scene {\n display: grid;\n grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr auto;\n align-items: baseline;\n gap: 4px 10px;\n padding: 7px 10px;\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.pp-map-scene--shown { opacity: 0.66; }\n\n.pp-map-scene--current {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 14%, transparent);\n opacity: 1;\n font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.pp-map-index { font-family: var(--pp-font-mono); font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.6; }\n.pp-map-title { font-size: 15px; }\n\n.pp-map-state {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 10px;\n letter-spacing: 0.08em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-map-anchors {\n grid-column: 2 / -1;\n list-style: none;\n margin: 4px 0 0;\n padding: 0;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 2px;\n}\n\n.pp-map-anchor {\n display: flex;\n align-items: baseline;\n justify-content: space-between;\n gap: 12px;\n padding: 5px 10px;\n border-left: 2px solid var(--pp-border);\n border-radius: 0 var(--pp-radius) var(--pp-radius) 0;\n font-size: 13px;\n font-weight: 400;\n cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n/*\n * Unshown branches are the point of this panel (§11), so they carry the accent\n * and shown ones recede. }\n\n.pp-contents-item--current {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 12%, transparent);\n font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.pp-contents-item--seen .pp-contents-title { opacity: 0.7; }\n\n.pp-contents-index { grid-area: index; font-family: var(--pp-font-mono); font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.6; }\n.pp-contents-title { grid-area: title; font-size: 16px; }\n.pp-contents-sub { grid-area: sub; font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.65; }\n\n.pp-contents-beats {\n grid-area: beats;\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 11px;\n opacity: 0.55;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n .pp-jump-result,\n .pp-map-scene,\n .pp-contents-item { transition: none; }\n}\n\n/* src/scene/scenes.css */\n/*\n * The scene stylesheet (L8).\n *\n * Bundled into `dist/pitchproof-runtime.css` behind `src/runtime/runtime.css`\n * and inlined into every artifact, so everything here is subject to the\n * artifact's laws rather than the studio's conveniences:\n *\n * - **`--pp-*` variables only** (D11, §15). The studio chrome's own variable\n * namespace may not appear anywhere under `src/scene/`, and\n * test/scene/css-agreement.test.mjs fails the build on any occurrence of it.\n * Colour comes from the brand theme's `--pp-*` roles; no literal hex\n * appears below, because the artifact wears the prospect's brand and\n * nobody else's.\n * - **No network of any kind** (§13): no imported stylesheet, no font URL, no\n * image URL, no remote anything. Every visual is a border, a background, a\n * gradient over brand colours, or inline SVG in the markup. The rule is\n * checked by test/scene/css-agreement.test.mjs over the whole directory,\n * including this comment — the file is bundled into the artifact verbatim.\n * - **The §10 motion budget**: the only animated properties are `opacity` and\n * `transform`, every duration is `var(--pp-transition-ms)` (200ms, capped at\n * 240 by `transitionMs()` in runtime/beats.js), and\n * `prefers-reduced-motion` removes them. Transitions on those two\n * properties are interruptible by definition — a reveal reversed mid-flight\n * lands on the state the beat engine asked for, never on a partial one.\n *\n * ------------------------------------------------------------------ geometry\n *\n * Every number in the `:root` blocks below is generated from `GEOM` and\n * `TYPE_ROLES` in `src/scene/tokens.js`, which is also what `measureScene()`\n * measures with. The two cannot drift: `test/scene/css-agreement.test.mjs`\n * parses this file and asserts each `:root` block declares exactly\n * `sceneVars(bp)`, and that each `[data-pp-tx]` rule matches its `TYPE_ROLES`\n * entry, value for value.\n *\n * The vertical model, for reading the rules below:\n *\n * content box = viewport - 2 x --pp-stage-pad (runtime.css)\n * header band = --pp-sc-head-h\n * body box = content box - header band - --pp-sc-head-gap\n *\n * Dimensions produced by a grid rather than by a token — the equal columns of a\n * split, the equal cards of a fan — are computed in geometry.js with the\n * formula `repeat(n, minmax(0,1fr))` plus `gap` actually produces, so the\n * agreement there is structural rather than copied.\n */\n\n/* sm — the base block: 390px viewport }\n.pp-jump-input::placeholder { color: var(--pp-on-surface-alt); opacity: 0.5; }\n\n.pp-jump-count {\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 12px;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-results {\n list-style: none;\n margin: 0;\n padding: 0;\n display: flex;\n flex-direction: column;\n gap: 2px;\n max-height: 46vh;\n overflow-y: auto;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result {\n display: grid;\n grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;\n grid-template-areas: 'objection meta' 'alias meta';\n align-items: baseline;\n gap: 2px 16px;\n padding: 10px 12px;\n border-radius: var(--pp-radius);\n border-left: 3px solid transparent;\n cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result--active {\n background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pp-accent) 14%, transparent);\n border-left-color: var(--pp-accent);\n}\n\n.pp-jump-objection {\n grid-area: objection;\n font-size: 17px;\n line-height: 1.35;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-alias {\n grid-area: alias;\n font-size: 13px;\n opacity: 0.72;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-meta {\n grid-area: meta;\n font-family: var(--pp-font-mono);\n font-size: 11px;\n letter-spacing: 0.04em;\n text-transform: uppercase;\n opacity: 0.6;\n white-space: nowrap;\n}\n\n.pp-jump-result--shown .pp-jump-objection { opacity: 0.62; The column formulas here are the ones geometry.js\n * computes with: `repeat(n, minmax(0,1fr))` plus a gap. */\n\n@media (min-width: 768px) {\n .pp-split-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--pp-sc-split-cols, 2), minmax(0, 1fr)); }\n\n .pp-fan {\n grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);\n grid-template-columns: var(--pp-sc-fan-source-w) minmax(0, 1fr);\n }\n .pp-fan-grid[data-pp-n=\"2\"] { --pp-sc-fan-cols: 2; }\n\n .pp-side-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) var(--pp-sc-note-w); }\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------ lg: 1400px and wider */\n\n@media (min-width: 1400px) {\n .pp-fan-grid[data-pp-n=\"3\"] { --pp-sc-fan-cols: 3; }\n}\n\n/* --------------------------------------------------------- reduced motion\n *\n * §10: `prefers-reduced-motion` is honoured. Nothing under `src/scene/`\n * animates once it is set — and because the only animated properties are\n * opacity and transform, removing the transition leaves the element in exactly\n * the state the beat engine asked for. */\n\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {\n .pp-layout,\n .pp-layout * {\n transition: none;\n animation: none;\n }\n}";
